audit.title: PANIN / Kshetra — Master Blueprint vs Repository Audit

findings.finding: Execution authority and repository state disagree.
findings.work: Added a 22-section scoped remediation plan and explicit branch-only authorization. Kept Stage B-only and external environment boundaries.
findings.remaining: Preserve historical W022 state while reconcile all current plan/decision/acceptance registers through the approved governance procedure; validate plan-gated CI against deliberate unauthorized changes.
findings.closureEvidence: Governance checks pass on the final head; independent reviewer verifies plan/directive lineage and register reconciliation.

findings.finding: Continuity registers are stale and contradict current blocker evidence.
findings.work: Recorded branch scope and source baseline; planning a 36-item matrix.
findings.remaining: Reconcile every continuity register and W021.5 register totals to the full 36 findings without overwriting historical statuses or claiming external acceptance.
findings.closureEvidence: Machine-checked reconciliation report and register consistency tests against the actual current master.

findings.finding: master is not protected by required branch rules.
findings.work: Blocking CI/security jobs were configured on the branch and master-trigger coverage corrected.
findings.remaining: Repository administrator must enable PR-only changes, required checks, CODEOWNERS/approvals, no force-push and no bypass. This connector session has not changed repository protection settings.
findings.closureEvidence: GitHub branch-protection/ruleset query and negative test proving a deliberately failing required check blocks merge.

findings.finding: CI/security/locale gates can falsely pass.
findings.work: Removed fail-open continue-on-error patterns; enabled strict locale checks and master workflow coverage; made npm audit, OSV, SAST and SBOM blocking.
findings.remaining: Current OSV and npm audit gates still report dependency advisories, and SBOM plus main CI checks are not yet green on final HEAD. Fix advisories and rerun all checks; do not suppress scanner failures.
findings.closureEvidence: All required workflow jobs green on exact head; deliberate lint, locale, vulnerability and missing-SBOM tests fail non-zero.

findings.finding: Build/lint package scripts were no-op placeholders.
findings.work: Replaced mobile build and API/shared lint echoes with actual commands.
findings.remaining: Confirm clean-install API/shared/mobile lint, build and typecheck; address all newly exposed errors.
findings.closureEvidence: Required jobs execute real commands on final SHA and pass.

findings.finding: EAS workflow did not cover active master branch and LFS.
findings.work: Corrected master trigger and configured LFS checkout for EAS/build jobs.
findings.remaining: Prove LFS object hydration in real EAS/CI checkout, produce signed/unsigned build artifacts as allowed and capture size report.
findings.closureEvidence: Successful master-triggered build with hydrated DB/data and archived verified artifact-size report.

findings.finding: Canonical state/constituency geography has placeholder or conflicting counts.
findings.work: Geography manifest now keeps only India overview bundled; assembly geometry is hidden unless source/effective/retrieval/version/hash/count provenance qualifies. Gate verified zero accepted remote boundary datasets; 31 assembly jurisdictions remain explicitly unavailable.
findings.remaining: Obtain and reconcile primary-source boundary artifacts, canonical AC identifiers/counts, legal-effective versions and topology; no placeholder/alternate mirror may be promoted to official.
findings.closureEvidence: Per-jurisdiction signed source/provenance/count/topology reconciliation report with zero unexplained differences.

findings.finding: Large national geometry/election seed datasets remain in the mobile dependency graph.
findings.work: Removed/bounded national polygon runtime path and made unsupported polygons unavailable.
findings.remaining: stateDataAdapter.ts and dispatcher still statically import constituency/election datasets; isolate state-scoped data from the consumer Metro graph, preserve IDs and measure actual AAB/APK size.
findings.closureEvidence: Metro dependency graph proves state-lazy data loading; verified APK/AAB/JS/native asset report within agreed target.

findings.finding: Competing static-seed and SQLite data paths exist; map still calls legacy dispatcher.
findings.work: Hardened SQLite seed builder/manifest gates and state-loader reset behavior.
findings.remaining: Migrate all map/data callers to one state-scoped versioned contract; explicit loading/offline/cached/unavailable states and retry/cancellation tests.
findings.closureEvidence: AST inventory and caller tests prove no synchronous all-state seed imports in critical map paths.

findings.finding: SQLite seed database and committed manifest are inconsistent and LFS object might not hydrate.
findings.work: Enabled LFS checkouts; seed builder uses canonical source slugs, fails on LFS pointers, malformed rows and empty constituency jurisdictions; imports historical results/timeline and removes false success artifacts.
findings.remaining: Current CI must build actual DB; verify representative/history/timeline rows, checksums, counts and manifest against database bytes from clean checkout.
findings.closureEvidence: Verified database artifact and SHA-256, per-table/state row counts, manifest parity and clean CI/EAS build evidence.

findings.finding: Seed loader can skip all subsequent state changes after one load.
findings.work: Ported state-switch load guard fix.
findings.remaining: Verify state A→B→A, overlapping requests, cancellation, failure/retry and empty-vs-error behavior with tests.
findings.closureEvidence: Automated lifecycle tests pass with bounded state-scoped cache.

findings.finding: Mobile data-truth metadata is inconsistently represented; unknown values become zero/empty.
findings.work: Added explicit dataTruth metadata to UnifiedConstituency, null preservation, scenario labeling, unknown source semantics, separated Assam projection from 2021 actual and ECI result URLs/votes with UNVERIFIED status pending Form-20.
findings.remaining: Apply the same source/retrieval/effective/version/status/transformation contract across all critical mobile/API adapters and seed schemas; fix consumers to render null as unavailable rather than coercing.
findings.closureEvidence: Full adapter inventory, static gate prohibiting default-zero for unknown critical facts, source-level fixtures and all call-site tests pass.

findings.finding: Canonical DB/geometry population and staging/production data state are not proven.
findings.work: Added forward reconciliation migration source only and preserved isolation boundary.
findings.remaining: A separately authorized disposable/Postgres then staging read-only catalog/source reconciliation must prove schema, RLS, canonical counts, geometry/demographic FKs and actual migration history; no staging/production access occurred.
findings.closureEvidence: Authorized DB catalog results plus independent reconciliation and formal acceptance; production remains untouched.

findings.finding: Campaign endpoints can return synthetic fixtures for empty/error DB.
findings.work: Removed selected campaign demo/in-memory fallbacks; updated route unit tests.
findings.remaining: Audit all campaign list/create/booth/volunteer/budget/analytics endpoints and verify no fallback in any production path.
findings.closureEvidence: DB-error, zero-row, provider outage, auth and persisted success/failure tests all pass against disposable Postgres.

findings.finding: Political-ad review queue can fall back to in-memory demo ads.
findings.work: Removed selected MEMORY_ADS production fallthrough and amended tests.
findings.remaining: Inspect all political-ad routes, certification/approval gates, auditing and state persistence across retries.
findings.closureEvidence: Negative test proves DB error cannot return demo ads and only human-certified ads enter delivery.

findings.finding: Manifesto voting and politician grievance workflows return 501 or fabricated empty results.
findings.work: No evidence of durable end-to-end implementation in this branch.
findings.remaining: Implement schema-backed workflow or return typed unavailable state without fake success; include auth, transitions, history, retry and notification/deep-link integration.
findings.closureEvidence: Actual persistent test journey from submission through vote/grievance state transitions.

findings.finding: Broadcast geography returns empty assembly results for all but three states.
findings.work: Removed several deceptive fallback paths in adjacent broadcast route changes.
findings.remaining: Complete canonical state-scoped result contract or explicitly typed unavailable status for unsupported state; no silent [] on unsupported/error.
findings.closureEvidence: State-by-state tests verify supported, unsupported, empty, offline and provider failure semantics.

findings.finding: Mobile direct Supabase queries can mask exceptions as empty data and mix API paths.
findings.work: Added broader API error dataStatus contract; hardened config failure paths.
findings.remaining: Inventory every direct Supabase/raw fetch operation; standardize EMPTY versus ERROR/OFFLINE/UNAVAILABLE; move sensitive writes through validated API.
findings.closureEvidence: Complete operation ownership matrix and negative adapter tests.

findings.finding: Supabase clients can use placeholder config or fall back from service role to anon.
findings.work: API Supabase bootstrap fails closed in production on invalid/missing URL or service-role credential; placeholders are test-only; mobile config verifier and runtime guards added.
findings.remaining: Verify all production callers fail readiness before use and public Expo variables cannot include privileged keys; run deployed-config tests only under authorization.
findings.closureEvidence: Unit/config negative tests and actual deployment environment audit.

findings.finding: Environment templates mix server-only secrets with mobile public variables.
findings.work: Updated .env example/mobile config boundary and runtime validation.
findings.remaining: Audit all env files/build workflows, secret scanning and EAS/Railway variables; separate server-only/public variable templates.
findings.closureEvidence: Secret scan clean, bundle inspection shows no privileged credentials, variable ownership matrix reviewed.

findings.finding: News ingestion remains a process-local RSS cache, lacking durable provenance and geographic/entity association.
findings.work: Not addressed beyond general governance/security gates.
findings.remaining: Implement durable source snapshots, provenance, transformed payload/version, canonical entity/geography mapping, errors and restart-safe ingestion; retain AI optional.
findings.closureEvidence: Replayable ingestion fixture and restart/retry tests with provenance records.

findings.finding: Webhook worker startup missing and SQL claim result shape mismatches TypeScript queue mapper.
findings.work: Webhook audit is included in plan and requires persistent claim mapping/worker verification.
findings.remaining: Implement real worker entrypoint/startup, map flat fn_claim_webhook_batch rows exactly, lease/ack semantics, bounded dispatch and shutdown; do not use in-memory mode in production.
findings.closureEvidence: Disposable PostgreSQL integration test claims row, dispatches once, settles and retries with leases; worker process observed running.

findings.finding: Webhook event persistence and delivery fan-out are non-atomic; duplicate retry may lose fan-out.
findings.work: No atomic DB RPC/transaction implementation yet.
findings.remaining: Move event insertion + scoped subscription resolution + delivery fan-out into one transactional DB function/transaction with idempotent repair semantics.
findings.closureEvidence: Fault injection between event/fan-out proves all-or-nothing; duplicate idempotency retries repair missing deliveries.

findings.finding: Webhook persistence silently becomes in-memory; encryption key has test fallback and mismatched env names.
findings.work: API service role config fail-closed, but webhook crypto/provider path still needs focused remediation.
findings.remaining: Require explicit durable queue config outside tests; unify env key names, fail startup/readiness on absent/invalid key, key rotation tests.
findings.closureEvidence: Negative startup tests and env matrix; production-like mode cannot choose in-memory queue or default encryption secret.

findings.finding: Webhook tenant/app scope, response overflow, and SaaS OpenAPI coverage incomplete.
findings.work: No confirmed full fix yet.
findings.remaining: Scope subscription selection to app ID, settle exactly once on overflow/error, add documented webhook operations to authoritative OpenAPI.
findings.closureEvidence: Cross-application negative isolation tests, response overflow tests, schema/spec parity gate.

findings.finding: W022 evidence bundle is not reproducible from tracked scripts/output.
findings.work: A general evidence-plan and branch CI artifacts are defined.
findings.remaining: Track all referenced concurrency/worker/security probes with exact commands, stdout, versions and hashes.
findings.closureEvidence: Clean-checkout evidence runner reproduces claimed result counts and hashes.

findings.finding: API contract drift gate covers only a narrow subset of routes/callers.
findings.work: No full AST inventory of all clients/routes completed.
findings.remaining: Expand route and client operation inventory to Fastify, raw fetch, Supabase and background jobs; derive OpenAPI/contract assertions.
findings.closureEvidence: Automated full operation inventory with unclassified operations = 0.

findings.finding: Account deletion, DPDP consent, retention and full privacy lifecycle are not demonstrated.
findings.work: No production-complete deletion lifecycle in this branch.
findings.remaining: Implement/validate data inventory, consent history, export/delete, retention and third-party erasure. Production/provider execution requires explicit authorization and compliance review.
findings.closureEvidence: End-to-end test account deletion across DB/storage/providers and compliance sign-off; audit event proves deletion completion.

findings.finding: Blueprint end-to-end citizen/creator/aspirant/journalist/campaign/advertiser/developer journeys are unverified.
findings.work: Unit/source-level gates improved; no end-to-end run claimed.
findings.remaining: Use disposable Postgres and provider sandboxes to execute all journeys; retain assertions, logs and generated artifacts.
findings.closureEvidence: Reproducible full persona journey matrix with no fixture-only completion.

findings.finding: Live production/staging health and actual APK/AAB/runtime are not verified.
findings.work: No production/staging traffic or database mutation was performed.
findings.remaining: After separate authorization, verify current deploy health/DB readiness, real AAB/APK and rollback; keep air-gap in place meanwhile.
findings.closureEvidence: Timestamped read-only health, build artifact hashes, latency/error logs, restore/rollback and independent acceptance.

findings.finding: Commercial, campaign, media and developer billing workflows are not certified end-to-end.
findings.work: No external payment/live-media/provider account action performed.
findings.remaining: Run sandbox transactions through ledger/spend/invoice/refund/replay and media/API billing journeys; require compliance/revenue review.
findings.closureEvidence: Provider IDs, transaction=ledger=spend=invoice reconciliation, playback/archive/analytics and API quota invoice records.

findings.finding: Store package IDs and EAS/store credentials contain placeholders or contradictions.
findings.work: No store/app-store configuration mutation performed.
findings.remaining: Resolve canonical Android package identifier, replace placeholder ASC/team/service files only with owner-provided credentials and validate store signing identities.
findings.closureEvidence: EAS profile validation and signed bundle metadata match approved store IDs and credentials.

findings.finding: react-native-webrtc remains in consumer mobile dependency graph.
findings.work: No measured dependency removal completed.
findings.remaining: Determine whether required broadcaster features can be separated into a separate app/optional bundle; measure native sizes before removal, keep no hidden regression.
findings.closureEvidence: Dependency graph and before/after APK/AAB native-library report prove target and broadcaster behavior.

findings.finding: No actual APK/AAB/JS/native size or performance evidence for blueprint target.
findings.work: Added export/report gate, but no accepted signed AAB/APK evidence yet.
findings.remaining: Run permitted build; measure AAB, universal/split APK, JS, assets, native libraries and app start/map/feed latency on target devices.
findings.closureEvidence: Reproducible artifact-size and device performance report.
